objective: Reproduce the finite-size reentrant boundary protocol of PRB 101, 024203 with PBC and test Cstag/H0 topology on the same states.

protocol.paper_observable: position-averaged signed Cstag at circular separation L/2-1
protocol.transition_estimator: zero crossing in h of the disorder-averaged paper observable
protocol.comparison_rule: Never pool PBC with OBC or fixed_mean with raw.

stages.gate: All scans complete; no unexplained branch failure; downloaded scans pass scripts/validate_pbc_scan_against_ed.py.
Compare energy, paper_distance_Cstag, bulk_ms2, matrices Cstag, saturation and branch QC at chi=64 and 128 before production.

stages.chi_gate_basis: chi64 and chi128 agree within 2.1e-11 in Cstag on 39 paired states; chi128 is retained as spot QC
stages.gate: The signed paper observable must have bracketed interior zero crossings and reproduce a positive finite-size shift around Gamma0 approximately 0.1-0.2 before topology is interpreted as a reentry detector.
Require stable transition-relevant observables and acceptable MaxRSS/runtime before the full L32 pilot.

stages.role: independent final cohort after freezing the physical and H0 landscape estimators on seeds 0-9

execution_split_2026_09_11.SECOND_PC: seeds 48-59; queue prepared for four simultaneous campaigns

stages.gate: Use seeds 10-59 for confirmatory bootstrap inference; seeds 0-9 remain discovery only. Require interior physical and H0 peaks, seed-split stability, branch-QC sensitivity and multi-seed chi spot checks before a final claim.

stages.role: preregistered multi-seed bond-dimension check paired point by point with the final chi64 cohort
stages.gate: Compare energy, the signed paper correlator, full Cstag matrices, H0 summaries and branch QC against exactly matched chi64 states before closing L16.

stages.role: small scientific cohort after L16 succeeds
stages.gate: Use only after L16 validates the physical estimator; decide additional seeds from bootstrap precision and chi QC.

L16.launch_after: observable choice and boundary estimator frozen on seeds 0-9

L32.launch_after: L32 timing, chi and physical reentry gates pass
